mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) compresses discount rates in equity valuation models, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as investors seek yield in equities during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS (low level) remains negative over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in low-rate periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate profit expectations and causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC for UNRATE (rising) is negative over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in rising UNRATE periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) over 3 months indicates broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime (INDPRO declining for 2 consecutive quarters), a further decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals worsening economic conditions, reducing corporate output expectations and causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative during recessionary INDPRO declines, or Rank IC for INDPRO in recessionary regimes is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 0.5 percentage points within 1 month signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS (rising) is negative over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in rising FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST > 1100) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, increasing corporate earnings growth expectations and generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST (high level) is negative over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in high-HOUST periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) over 3 months indicates broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (relative to 2017 base) signals a significant manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate output expectations and causing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO (below 100) is negative over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns in such periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
